# part of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/partOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Universal part-to-whole relation: relates any GMEOW thing to a larger whole it is part of. Transitive and intentionally broad; use specialized subproperties such as [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md), [`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md), [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md), [`gmeow:partOfThread`](gmeow-partOfThread.md) or module-specific component properties when the kind of parthood matters. No domain/range is asserted so event, location, information-object and endurant parthood all remain possible in OWL 2 DL.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.

### Sensitivity And Disclosure

- **Source:** [`slices/core/kernel/examples/sensitivity-and-disclosure.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/kernel/examples/sensitivity-and-disclosure.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-kernel-examples-sensitivity-and-disclosure)#example-slices-core-kernel-examples-sensitivity-and-disclosure

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: the kernel disclosure machinery (Principles 10 and 12). Any entity can
# declare HOW SENSITIVE it is (gmeow:hasSensitivity), the POLICY governing its
# release (gmeow:hasDisclosurePolicy), and WHICH CONSUMERS are eligible to receive
# it (gmeow:eligibleForConsumer → a ProjectionContext). This is the projection/
# disclosure boundary: a confidential record is never deleted, only withheld from
# the wrong consumer (P10 suppression, P12 solver/presentation split). Part-whole
# mereology (gmeow:partOf / gmeow:hasPart) and gmeow:hasDeterminacy (how crisp the
# value is) are the other kernel primitives every slice reuses.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/kernel/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

# --- A confidential record: sensitive, internal-only, eligible only for the
#     internal archive — withheld from public consumers, not deleted.
ex:salaryRecord a gmeow:InformationObject ;
    rdfs:label                "Compensation record"@en ;
    gmeow:partOf              ex:dossier ;
    gmeow:hasSensitivity      gmeow:sensitivityConfidential ;
    gmeow:hasDisclosurePolicy gmeow:policyInternalOnly ;
    gmeow:eligibleForConsumer gmeow:consumerInternalArchive ;
    gmeow:hasDeterminacy      gmeow:determinacyCrisp .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a generic consumer needs to ask whether one thing is part of a larger whole across domains, or to query the transitive part/whole closure without committing to a specific kind of parthood.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the kind of parthood matters — use a narrower subproperty ([`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md), [`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md), [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md), [`gmeow:partOfThread`](gmeow-partOfThread.md)) — and avoid relying on proper-part, direct-part, or asymmetry semantics, none of which are asserted here.

### How to use

- Assert the most specific part/whole subproperty for the domain; generic consumers then read [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md) by inheritance. Model time-scoped or role-bearing parthood as a relator rather than on this simple transitive spine.

### Scope notes

- No cardinality, functionality, asymmetry or irreflexivity is asserted on this transitive property. Proper-part, direct-part and time-scoped mutable parthood must be modelled with narrower simple properties or relators when needed.
